ios.desc:
DayAware helps you track public holidays across countries without mixing them into your personal calendar.

Whether you work with international teammates, travel often, support clients in different regions, or keep in touch with friends and family abroad, DayAware makes it easier to know when a country has a public holiday.

WHY DAYAWARE

• View public holidays by country
Select the countries you care about and see their holidays in one focused app.

• Daily and monthly views
Check what is happening today, this week, or later in the month.

• Holiday reminders
Get notified before important public holidays so you can plan messages, meetings, travel, and deadlines with more awareness.

• Built for global work and life
Useful for remote teams, freelancers, digital nomads, expats, international families, and anyone coordinating across countries.

• No personal calendar clutter
DayAware is dedicated to public holidays, so you can stay aware without filling your main calendar with extra events.

COMMON USE CASES

• Avoid scheduling meetings during a teammate’s public holiday
• Check upcoming holidays before sending work messages
• Follow holidays in countries where your family or friends live
• Plan travel around national holidays
• Track public holidays for clients, vendors, or remote teams

DayAware supports public holiday tracking for many countries and regions, with a clean day-level experience designed for quick awareness.
